title: Max-Stable Survival Copulas under Dependent Censoring: Sharp Identification and Efficient Inference
summary: We study dependent censoring within a generalized Cox first-hitting-time. framework based on compensator reductions. In the genuinely dependent case, we show that max-stability of the associated survival copula is equivalent to a common operational clock, leading to a nonparametric Marshall Olkin family. We establish sharp identification results under complete and binary observation schemes.
